User’s guide to viscosity solutions of second order partial diferential equations. Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.) 27 (1992), no. 1, 1–67.

This is a self-contained presentation and survey of results involving the powerful and conceptually simple concept of viscosity solutions.
